# Cancelling an order

Use your private confirmation link to cancel unpaid bread and pastry orders before the day of pickup. Birthday cakes and catering need at least 48 hours’ notice. For same-day, paid orders, or shorter notice, call 555-010-0000 so staff can review the order and any refund.

Cancellation restores credit used from a gift card and voids unused cards bought on the cancelled order. A purchased card that has already been spent requires staff review. Recording a cancellation does not issue a cash or card refund; staff must handle and record that separately.

# Refunds and returns

If something isn't right, bring it back with your receipt within 14 days for a refund or exchange.
Unused gift cards can be refunded within 14 days of purchase.
Custom cakes and catering can't be returned once collected.
files.policies/gift_cards.md:
# Gift card terms

Gift cards can be used in the bakery and online. They have no expiry date and no service or inactivity fees.
Cards bought online become spendable once staff record payment at pickup.
Unused, paid gift cards can be refunded within 14 days with proof of purchase, consistent with our refund policy. Once partly used, please contact the bakery for review. Cards cannot be exchanged for cash except where required by law.
Please contact us about lost or stolen cards with proof of purchase; replacement depends on verifying the card and its remaining balance.
